name: get_todo_tasks
description: Use this tool to fetch all todo lists
arguments_prompt:
- **Purpose**: Fetch to-do tasks.
- **Default behavior**: returns active (not completed) tasks across lists, including overdue items.
- **Arguments**:
  - `start_date` (str, optional): Start of due-date filter window (ISO 8601).
  - `end_date` (str, optional): End of due-date filter window (ISO 8601).
  - `include_completed` (bool, optional, default false): Set true only when explicitly asked to include completed tasks.
